verdict.rationale: RUN documents a built-in, AI-powered virtual assistant, but the evidence only shows it answering payroll and HR questions, not carrying out delegated tasks. Other AI features (error flagging, timesheet import) are standalone automations rather than an assistant, and ADP Assist belongs to the separate API Central developer product. Missing for 10: evidence that the assistant executes tasks (e.g., running payroll or updating employee records) on the user's behalf, documentation of the assistant's scope and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Powered by AI, the virtual assistant instantly answers your business’s payroll and HR questions.
